prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0011",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 55,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03106-03108",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "そう、判ったわ。\nトレン！　自警団の所に行って今の事を話してきて",
      "en": "Right, got it.\nTren! Go to the watch and tell them what happened."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03110-03120",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "トレン\n判りました！\nリンシャに言われた厨房係の青年が扉を開けて\n駆け出していった。\nリシカ\nリンシャさん\nそれと入れ替わる様に司祭を呼びに行っていた給仕の娘が\n戻ってくる。",
      "en": "Tren\nUnderstood!\nAt Rinsha's order, the kitchen youth\nopened the door and dashed out.\nRishika\nRinsha...\nJust then, the serving girl sent to fetch\nthe priest came back, as if taking her place."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03126-03134",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "神官服の女性\n此方の方ですね\nリシカに続いて店内に入ってきた神官服の女性は、\n床に寝かされているランドの傍らに跪くと\n直ぐに癒しの祈りを唱え始めた。\n俺は今迄治癒術を掛け続けていたシュリの肩に手を置くと、\n下がらせて疲労の為にふらつくその身体を支えてやった。",
      "en": "A woman in priestly robes. \"This is the one, right?\" Following Rishika inside, the woman in priestly robes knelt beside Rando on the floor and immediately began chanting a healing prayer. I placed my hand on Shuri's shoulder, who had been continuously applying healing magic, and pulled her back, supporting her swaying body from fatigue."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03140-03141",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "申し訳ありません",
      "en": "I am sorry."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03143-03144",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "気にするな",
      "en": "Forget it."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03150-03151",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "神官服の女性\nもう、大丈夫ですよ",
      "en": "The woman in priestly robes spoke. \"It's all right now.\""
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03155-03156",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "治癒術を行使していた女司祭の声が聞こえた。\n見るとランドの傷は、ほぼ完全に癒えていた。",
      "en": "I heard the voice of the priestess performing the healing magic.\nLooking, I saw that Rando's wound had almost completely healed."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03163-03164",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（こんな短時間で施術し終えるとは大した力だの）",
      "en": "To complete the healing so swiftly... impressive power indeed."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03166-03167",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "（ああ）",
      "en": "Mm."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03173-03174",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rando",
      "jp": "ありがとうございます、クーン司祭様",
      "en": "Thank you, Priestess Kuun."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03176-03177",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そのクーンと呼ばれた司祭の着ている神官服から彼女が\n癒しの神として名高いイーリュンの司祭であることが判る。",
      "en": "From the priestly robe she wore, I could tell that the priestess called Kuun served Iryun, the renowned healing god."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03183-03185",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Kuun",
      "jp": "いえ、いいのですよ、\nそれよりもどうなさったのですか、この傷は？",
      "en": "Oh, it is nothing. But more importantly, what caused this wound?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03191-03192",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rando",
      "jp": "ええ、実は……",
      "en": "Yes, well..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03194-03195",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ランドがもう一度、アリシアが攫われた事を話していると、\n自警団の所へ行った厨房係のトレンが戻ってきた。",
      "en": "While Rando recounted Alicia's kidnapping,\nTren, the kitchen youth, returned from the watch."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03201-03202",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "どうだった、自警団の方は？",
      "en": "So, how did it go with the watch?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03204-03205",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "トレン\nええ、捜索隊を出してくれるそうですが……",
      "en": "Tren\nYes, they plan to send a search party, but..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03207-03208",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ですが……何よ？",
      "en": "But... what?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03210-03215",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "トレン\n何か、自警団の人とレウィニアの軍隊の人が\n喧嘩してて、大丈夫かなぁって……\nレヴィアとカウラか……\n何をやっているのだか……",
      "en": "Tren\nWell, the watch and the Lewinia soldiers\nwere arguing. I wondered if it was okay...\nLevia and Kaura, huh...\nWhat are they doing..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03217-03220",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "だ、大丈夫よ、自警団だってこうゆう時の為に居るんだし、\nもしかしたらレウィニアの軍隊の人も\n探してくれるかも知れないわ",
      "en": "It's okay, the watch is for emergencies like this,\nand maybe the Lewinia soldiers\nwill help search too, you know."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03222-03223",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "一瞬、悲愴な顔になったランドをリンシャが元気づける。\n仕方がないな……",
      "en": "For an instant, Rando wore a sorrowful look, and\nRinsha cheered him up.\n...It cannot be helped."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03225-03226",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "行って来る",
      "en": "I'll go."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03228-03228",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺はシュリを椅子に座らせると、戸口へと向かった。",
      "en": "I seated Shuri on a chair and headed for the door."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03234-03235",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、御主人様……",
      "en": "Ah, Master..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:03238-03239",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "外まで俺を送る為に立ち上がろうとしたシュリを手で制して\n俺は扉を開けて店の外へと出た。",
      "en": "I stopped Shuri with a hand as she tried to rise to see me off, then opened the door and went outside."
    }
  ]
}
